body: Recontextualize a coffee machine as a transparent precision artifact: optical-glass body exposes water tubes, pressure chamber, grinder and extraction path; physical orange circuitry; coffee pouring into a matching glass cup; high-end editorial lighting on a seamless light-gray cyclorama. Clear coherent machine structure, no clutter or neon glow. Single machine and single cup. Concept visualization, 4:5 portrait, no labels or logos.
